statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-107161 affects the Cyrus SASL DIGEST-MD5 plugin (libdigestmd5.so). Debian ships that plugin in the optional libsasl2-modules package (https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/libsasl2-modules/filelist), which this image does not contain. The image contains only the libsasl2 core library and the sasldb plugin.

CVE-2026-107161 affects the Cyrus SASL DIGEST-MD5 plugin (libdigestmd5.so). Debian ships that plugin in the optional libsasl2-modules package (https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/libsasl2-modules/filelist), which this image does not contain. The image contains only the libsasl2 core library and the sasldb plugin.

CVE-2026-107161 affects the DIGEST-MD5 plugin's add_to_challenge() function. This image installs only the Cyrus SASL core library and Berkeley DB plugin; it does not install the libsasl2-modules package containing the vulnerable libdigestmd5 plugin. See https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-107161.
